name: Server Simulator!
desc:
Welcome to Server Simulator, where the possibilities are endless and the power to create your own server empire is in your hands! All you have to do is click on your servers to earn money, then use that money to buy upgrades and build more powerful machines!

So what are you waiting for? Join the world of Server Simulator today and experience the thrill of building your own servers

X2 Cash on weekends!
